Zayane is seventy-five years old and has never gone outside the borders of the high-rise projects she lives in. One day she receives a letter concerning the death of a man she once knew in Algeria. While she is absent for a day, collecting a box the deceased man has left to her, her eleven children get together in her apartment and discover a side to their mother's life that none of them knew about until then.
